title: CNH's 'A Sustainable Year' series spotlights sustainable - GlobeNewswire
description: CNH's Lecce plant in Italy has started production of its first electric compact wheel loader. The plant has a large photovoltaic power installation that reduces CO2 emissions by over 1,200 tons per year. The site produces machines for CNH's CASE Construction Equipment and New Holland Construction brands.

title: CNH to release 2024 Second Quarter financial results on July 31 - GlobeNewswire

title: CNH expands capabilities at India Technology Center - GlobeNewswire
description: CNH is expanding its India Technology Center in Gurugram, Northern India, with the addition of a new Multi-Vehicle Simulator (MVS). The MVS enables virtual testing and evaluation of products before physical prototypes are built, reducing waste and improving product quality.

title: Global Tractor Market Size To Worth USD 129.25 Billion By 2033 | CAGR OF 5.42% - GlobeNewswire
description: The global tractor market is expected to grow from USD 76.23 billion in 2023 to USD 129.25 billion by 2033, driven by factors like rising labor costs, increasing food consumption, and government incentives. The 31-100 HP segment and farm tractor segment are expected to dominate the market.

title: Global Agricultural & Forestry Machinery Market Size To Worth USD 576.12 Billion By 2033 | CAGR of 5.40% - GlobeNewswire
description: The global agricultural and forestry machinery market is expected to grow from $340.36 billion in 2023 to $576.12 billion by 2033, at a CAGR of 5.40%. title: CNH’s ‘A Sustainable Year’ series spotlights education projects in Brazil - GlobeNewswire
description: CNH Industrial supports environmental education, diversity, and other programs at rural schools in Brazil's northeast, reaching over 15,000 children through engaging activities like audio books, workshops, and theater productions.
